pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with smooth pixel gradients at the edges rather than sharp transitions. The relative spatial area of dark regions is significantly larger on the central flank compared to the smaller, more elongated geometries on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous graph of light-colored pathways with tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank but narrows significantly at junctions between neck patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder, characterized by a fine, hair-like textural fringe against the sky background.
